name: VivoTube
author: hamburger101
description:
VivoTube is an unofficial YouTube client for PSVita written from scratch. It communicates directly with YouTube's InnerTube API, without a companion server, and plays videos at up to 720p using the console's hardware H.264 and AAC decoders.
It includes a Home page with topic feeds and a personal "For you" feed built from watch history and likes, a vertical Shorts player, search with filters, comments with replies, captions, chapters, a mini player, a play queue, and playback speeds from 0.25x to 2x with pitch-preserving audio. Subscriptions, watch history, Watch later, liked videos and playlists are stored on the memory card. Signing in with a Google account, through an OAuth client the user creates, syncs subscriptions, likes and playlists. Text in non-Latin scripts such as Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Thai, Chinese, Japanese and Korean is displayed with bundled Noto fonts, and emoji are shown in colour. A built-in updater installs new releases from the project's GitHub repository.
